# Proof re-affirmation on the final main, BEFORE mission 02's release review (your slices)

From the lead's scheduled item qitem-20261003195138-8eb72ecb, now routed. Final product tree: main at
`30f8de4e` (all six mission-02 slices merged; release prep running on it). No more slices will merge, so the
shared QA documents should now stay still; run this now so release review and the human's ship decision see
ready proof. A small second round follows the delivery stamps (stamps write SPEC frontmatter).

## Your slices (no proofPolicy override, so the default judge qa-agent)

- missions 01: `01-create-redirect`, `02-analytics`
- missions 02: `01-audit-read`, `03-dogfood-fix`

## Ask, per slice

1. `rig proof show <mission>/slices/<slice> --json`; list every item not accepted.
2. For each one whose only change is a moved hash of a shared or living file (docs/qa/GAPS.md,
   TRACEABILITY.md, docs/DESIGN.md, docs/diagrams/erd.mmd, a stamped SPEC), confirm the slice's own content
   is unchanged and re-affirm, citing `30f8de4e`. Non-missions/ evidence paths slice-relative.
3. A real content change is a finding to me, not a re-affirmation. Do not re-judge accepted items.
4. Plain `rig proof judge` command lines.

Evidence: a short table under docs/qa/final-reaffirmation/qa.md, one explicit-pathspec commit. Close
no-follow-on with the commit, receipt numbers and each slice's readiness.
summary: Final-main proof re-affirmation before mission 02 release review: 01-create-redirect, 02-analytics, 01-audit-read, 03-dogfood-fix at 30f8de4e
